**Answer – All places that define a `ServiceSpec` structthat need to be updated**

The three projects you mentioned (Cilium, Istio, and ingress‑nginx) each compile their own copy of the Kubernetes core API types.  
In each repository the `ServiceSpec` struct lives in the vendored copy of `k8s.io/api/core/v1/types.go`.  
Cilium also defines its own *Cilium‑specific* `ServiceSpec` model used by the Cilium HTTP API.

Below is the complete list of files that contain a `ServiceSpec` struct definition and therefore must be changed to keep the three projects in sync.

| Project / Repo | File (relative to repo root) | Why this file matters |
|----------------|------------------------------|-----------------------|
| **Cilium** (repo `ab057f46‑1b78‑43c7‑84b3‑bc98fd2c5101`) | `api/v1/models/service_spec.go` | Cilium’s own Swagger‑generated API model for a Service. It mirrors the Kubernetes `ServiceSpec` but adds Cilium‑specific fields; any change to the core spec must be reflected here. |
| Cilium | `addon-resizer/vendor/k8s.io/api/core/v1/types.go` | Vendored copy of the Kubernetes core API used by the *addon‑resizer* component. Contains the canonical `type ServiceSpec struct { … }`. |
| Cilium | `staging/src/k8s.io/api/core/v1/types.go` | Another vendored copy (used by the main Cilium code). Also defines the canonical `ServiceSpec`. |
| **Istio** (repo `edd43087‑bf39‑42b6‑85b0‑ed3297ec760a`) | `vendor/k8s.io/api/core/v1/types.go` | Istio’s vendored Kubernetes core API – the only place the `ServiceSpec` struct lives in the Istio code base. |
| **Ingress‑nginx** (repo `f9267125‑4d0d‑4ca5‑9dc1‑dd944557f55c`) | `vendor/k8s.io/api/core/v1/types.go` | Ingress‑nginx also vendors the core API; this file defines the `ServiceSpec` struct used by its controller. |
| **Ingress‑nginx** (additional copy) | `staging/src/k8s.io/api/core/v1/types.go` | Some builds of ingress‑nginx pull the staging copy of the core API – also contains `ServiceSpec`. |
| **Ingress‑nginx** (additional copy) | `addon-resizer/vendor/k8s.io/api/core/v1/types.go` | If the ingress‑nginx repo includes the *addon‑resizer* sub‑module, it also vendors the core types here. |

> **What to change?**  
> - Update the field list, JSON tags, validation tags, or default values in **all** of the files above.  
> - After the change, run the code‑generation steps that each project uses (e.g., `make generate` for Cilium, `make gen` for Istio, `make generate` for ingress‑nginx) so that any generated client‑sets, informers, deep‑copy functions, and Swagger/OpenAPI specs are regenerated from the new struct definition.  
> - Run the full test suites of each project (`make test` / `go test ./...`) to ensure the change does not break any downstream code that relies on the old layout.

By updating every vendored copy of `k8s.io/api/core/v1/types.go` **and** the Cilium‑specific API model, you guarantee that Cilium, Istio, and ingress‑nginx all see the same `ServiceSpec` definition. This eliminates mismatches that could otherwise cause compilation errors, runtime panics, or API incompatibilities.
